elements.text: Where is my meeting ID? In the invitation, or under Meetings in the app. It is 10 or 11 digits; the passcode is separate.
Why did my meeting end at 40 minutes? Basic (free) accounts have a 40-minute limit on group meetings. The host can start a new meeting immediately.
Can I join without an account? Yes. Only the host needs an account. Enter the meeting ID and your name.
Copyright 2026 Zoom Communications, Inc. Prices in US dollars. Simulated site.
Updated 4 February 2026. Applies to Zoom Workplace 7.x on desktop, mobile and web.
Click the link in your invitation. The app opens if it is installed; otherwise choose "Join from your browser". Enter your name and, if asked, the passcode.
Open the app and choose Join, or go to the join page on zoom.us. Type the 10 or 11 digit meeting ID and your display name. The host may keep you in a waiting room until they admit you.
Dial the number in the invitation, then enter the meeting ID followed by #. Press *6 to mute and *9 to raise your hand.
On a Zoom Room or an SIP/H.323 system, dial the meeting ID from the controller. Zoom Rooms with one-touch join show the meeting on the calendar.
Copyright 2026 Zoom Communications, Inc. Prices in US dollars. Simulated site.

Check that you are not muted (the microphone icon in the bottom left). Click the arrow next to it and pick the right microphone. On macOS and Windows, confirm Zoom has microphone permission in system settings. Try "Test Speaker and Microphone".

Click the arrow next to the microphone icon and choose the right speaker. If you joined from the browser, make sure the tab is not muted. On mobile, tap "Join Audio" if the audio icon shows a red line.
Echo means two devices in the same room are both unmuted. Mute one, or use headphones. Turning on "Suppress background noise: High" under Audio settings helps with keyboards and fans.
Turn off video, move closer to the Wi-Fi access point or plug in Ethernet. Zoom needs about 80 kbps for audio alone.
Copyright 2026 Zoom Communications, Inc. Prices in US dollars. Simulated site.

Available on every plan on desktop. Click Record, then "Record on this Computer". When the meeting ends, Zoom converts the file to MP4 and M4A in Documents/Zoom. Participants see a recording indicator and hear an announcement.

Available on Pro and above. Click Record, then "Record to the Cloud". The recording, the transcript and the AI Companion summary appear under Recordings on the web portal within an hour. Pro plans include 5GB.
Open the recording in the web portal, click Share, and choose whether viewers need to sign in, whether they can download, and an expiry date. The link and a passcode are copied for you.

elements.text: AI Companion now takes notes in 30 languages
26 February 2026. By the Zoom product team.

Starting today, AI Companion generates meeting summaries, next steps and in-meeting answers in 30 languages, including Japanese, Portuguese, Hindi, Korean and Arabic. Summaries follow the language spoken in the meeting, and a host can pin the output language for a multilingual team.
Also new: "Catch me up" now works for late joiners in any supported language, smart recording chapters are generated for cloud recordings, and the summary can be sent straight to a Team Chat channel.
AI Companion is included in every paid plan at no extra cost. Admins turn it on under Account Settings, AI Companion.
Copyright 2026 Zoom Communications, Inc. Prices in US dollars. Simulated site.
The team records to the cloud so the postmortem, if there is one, can quote the review. AI Companion writes the action items into the team's chat channel before the call ends.
Their advice for small teams: keep the meeting short, keep the checklist boring, and make one person the owner.
